definitions.explanation: Making something shorter in time, length, or duration. Used for work hours, distances, processes, and similar measurable things.

examples.japanese: {労働|ろうどう}{時間|じかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}する。
{新|あたら}しい{道路|どうろ}のおかげで{通勤|つうきん}{時間|じかん}が{短縮|たんしゅく}された。
examples.english: Commuting time was reduced thanks to the new road.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{時間|じかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}するために、{事前|じぜん}に{資料|しりょう}を{配布|はいふ}することにした。
examples.english: We decided to distribute materials in advance to shorten meeting times.

notes:
USAGE:
Used transitively ({短縮|たんしゅく}する = to shorten) or in the passive ({短縮|たんしゅく}される = to be shortened). Also used as a noun modifier: {短縮|たんしゅく}{版|ばん} (abbreviated version), {短縮|たんしゅく}URL (shortened URL).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間|じかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}する: to shorten time
- {営業|えいぎょう}{時間|じかん}の{短縮|たんしゅく}: reduction of business hours
- {短縮|たんしゅく}{営業|えいぎょう}: shortened business hours
- URL{短縮|たんしゅく}: URL shortening
- {工期|こうき}を{短縮|たんしゅく}する: to shorten the construction period

CONTRAST:
- {延長|えんちょう}: extension, lengthening (the opposite)
